messages.subject_clean: Jackknife test and Permutation Importance on enviro data
messages.body_plain:
Hi Dimitris,

This option is not available on Wallace. Although once you build your model with the Rmarkdown, you can use the ENMeval::var.importance() function to get percent contribution and permutation importance.

Best,
Gonzalo

messages.subject: Re: Can't download session data
messages.body_plain:
Hi João,

I think there is a problem of communication between RStudio and pandoc. Please, run the following lines and let me know their results.
>Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO_PANDOC")
>rmarkdown::pandoc_version()
>rmarkdown::pandoc_available()

I hope that with this information, we can find a solution for your problem.

Best,
Gonzalo
